title: ficus laevigata var. genuina
intro:
Ficus laevigata var. genuina, commonly known as the smooth-barked banyan or small-leaved banyan, is a variety of the Ficus banyan tree. This plant has been traditionally used in various cultures for its medicinal and therapeutic properties, with reported health benefits including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, which may help to lower cholesterol levels and improve cardiovascular health. The therapeutic actions of Ficus laevigata var. genuina include its ability to act as an anti-inflammatory and antioxidant agent, as well as a potential antidiabetic and antilipemic agent. The bioactive constituents of this plant have been identified as containing flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
